articles.body:
Had a situation crop up last night that I hadn’t seen before.

A Crisis -1 triggered a Rebellion in a Company controlled region with no unrest, so the total strength of the attack was minus one.

So … the Commander doesn’t need to exhaust any troops to successfully defend against it, right?
In such cases the uprising is just swatted away or never got going in the first place I assume - or have I missed something?

articles.body:
I'd say that rebellion was dead on arrival...

Next things would be:
1) Commander getting a trophy for doing nothing.
2) Resolve rebellions in any other company-controlled regions with unrest cubes, the attacker's force being only the unrest cubes, so without the -1 of the event.
3) Elephant marches to the region depicted on the top of the stack.
